newsitem.title: UK: Shield lower after executive option sales.
newsitem.headline: Shield lower after executive option sales.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Group Plc were lower in morning trading on Monday after three senior managers sold shares worth a total of 795,000 stg.
Shares in the company were down 30 pence at 532 1/2 pence by 0920 GMT, recovering from a low of 520 pence.

The company, which has seen its value rise sharply this year on the back of optimism about a diagnostic test for vulnerability to heart attacks, said in a statement that managing director Gordon Hall had exercised options on 70,000 shares at 35 pence per share. He sold the shares for 530 pence each, netting a profit of 346,500 stg.
